body.text:
**The MCP server is verified and committed** (`248429a`) — agents are now first-class citizens of the intent layer. Any MCP-capable agent gets `ask`, `blame_why`, `show`, `log_intent`, `doctor`, and the schema-validated `annotate` write tool natively, with no console parsing. Each tool wraps the exact same pure function its CLI command uses, so behavior can never drift between the two surfaces. When you want it in your own Claude Code, it's one line from any repo:

```
claude mcp add git-for-ai -- git-for-ai mcp
```

My verification: 208 CLI tests green on my run (15 new, including the built server driven over *real* stdio by the SDK's own client, with both API-key variables pinned empty so tests can never spend your key), and I personally inspected the one seam that warranted it — the test-embedder env hook is dynamically imported and inert in production. The agent's stdio dogfood on this repo returned real history through the protocol: `show HEAD` came back with the full change-map entry and the agent-authored ledger record for the CLI-completion commit.

**One item left on the entire board**: the review-page redesign (task #14), still in flight — ask panel to the top, human-first hierarchy, browser-verified before it reports. When that lands and passes verification, everything you've asked for is built: a feature-complete CLI, the ledger in its merge-safe JSONL format, sync with no server, a report page, a live review app designed for you, and agents wired in natively via MCP. I'll close it out and push the lot as soon as it reports.
The last item is in. Independent verification — build, tests, and my own live smoke test of the redesigned page:

attributes.command: cd C:/src/git-for-ai && pnpm turbo build --force 2>&1 | grep "Tasks:" && cd packages/review-ui && pnpm vitest run 2>&1 | grep -E "Tests "

cd C:/src/git-for-ai && node packages/cli/dist/bin.js review --no-open --port 47989 & sleep 3 && curl -s http://127.0.0.1:47989/ | grep -o "Ask this repository" | head -1 && curl -s http://127.0.0.1:47989/api/overview | head -c 120 && echo && kill %1 2>/dev/null

cd C:/src/git-for-ai && git add packages/review-ui && git commit -q -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
Review UI v2: redesigned for its one reader - the human

Owner direction applied: the page is for humans only (agents consume
the CLI's --json, stated plainly in the footer), so the layout is now
opinionated. Ask is the hero - "Ask this repository" at the top with
suggestion chips and citation-linked answers; sources fold closed when
prose exists and open when they ARE the answer. The stat grid became a
one-line digest; the attention queue is an inbox grouped by WHY items
need a human (unreadable notes -> low confidence -> inferred -> no
intent), severity-ordered with plain-English explanations; the
timeline groups under day headings, summary-first.

Change detail is claim-next-to-evidence: summary as the title, then an
Evidence block (tested + session trace link) directly beneath, then
intent/constraints/rejected. Internals are demoted, not deleted:
change-ids, change-map origin/revisions, provenance enum, full shas
and scope file lists live behind closed "Record details"/count folds;
the provenance pill only speaks when noteworthy (inferred).

No API changes needed; server rules untouched. 41 tests (up from 30;
new pure helpers groupByDay/groupAttention/isNoteworthyProvenance all
tested); no-external-requests assertion passes against the new build.
Agent-verified in a real browser against this repo (ask returned a
live synthesized cited answer; only-127.0.0.1 network log) and
independently rebuilt, re-tested, and smoke-served before commit.

Implemented by a background Fable 5 agent; committed by the
orchestrating session.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)" && git push origin main "+refs/notes/git-for-ai/*:refs/notes/git-for-ai/*" "+refs/git-for-ai/*:refs/git-for-ai/*" 2>&1 | tail -4

summary: claude-code session: 5 tool execution(s), 2 model turn(s) for commit "Review UI v2: redesigned for its one reader - the human".
